subject: Runbookize: convert intro demo to technical roadmap workshop — need to move dates
messages:
From: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@clearviewhealth.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro demo request — Clearview AI use cases

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the earlier intro. We’d like to get a 45-minute demo next week to see how Redwood would fit into our clinical document ingestion pipeline. Our exec (Priya) and a couple of engineering leads (myself + one infra lead) should join.

What times do you have Wednesday–Thursday afternoon PT? If it helps, our goals: 1) latency & cost breakdown for common batch sizes, 2) integration pattern for VPC/private deployments, and 3) a sketch of rollout phases.

Best,
Chris Nolan
Director, Data Platform
Clearview Health

---
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro demo request — Clearview AI use cases

Hi Chris — thanks for the details and the goals, those are super helpful. Wednesday/Thursday afternoon PT both work on our side; I can do Wed 2:00pm PT or Thu 3:30pm PT. Which is better for you and Priya?

Quick note — given the list of goals and the presence of engineering leads, would you be open to converting the session from a 45-minute product intro to a 90-minute technical roadmap workshop? That would let us:
- bring a solutions engineer to walk through an integration runbook (networking, auth, data flows)
- show performance profiles on similar batch sizes and trade-offs (latency vs. quantization)
- sketch a phased rollout plan aligned to compliance checkpoints

If you’re open to that, I’ll add Marissa (solutions engineer) and Rishi (infrastructure) to the invite and share a short prework questionnaire so we can tailor the demo. I attached a draft agenda and the prework outline — happy to trim if you prefer to stay at 45 minutes.

Options: Wed 2027-02-17 14:00 PT (90m) or Thu 2027-02-18 15:30 PT (90m).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_roadmap_agenda.pdf, prework-questionnaire.md

Hi Aditya — thanks for the agenda and for proposing the workshop format. Our CISO has asked for a deeper architecture conversation and Priya (me) would prefer the 90-minute workshop so we can cover telemetry, compliance controls, and a migration roadmap.

That said, we have a conflict on Wed 2:00pm PT — our infra lead will be traveling and not available that afternoon. Thu 3:30pm PT looks possible but I need to confirm Priya’s calendar; can you hold Thu 15:30 PT for us? If Priya confirms, we will add an extra infra engineer (Maya Kulkarni) and our platform architect (Samir Patel).

Also: can you confirm whether you’ll record the session and whether we can get a copy of the prework responses back to our security team?

Thanks,
Priya Shah
VP Product, Clearview Health
priya.shah@clearviewhealth.com
